account.title: Account
config.issue.db.title: Database integrity check failed
config.issue.db.impact: Integrity check reports: {status}. Reliable game operation cannot be guaranteed.
config.issue.db.solution: Do not start new games. Back up and inspect the database outside the application.
config.issue.course_empty.title: {code}: no active students
config.issue.course_empty.impact: A regular game with students cannot be prepared for this course.
config.issue.course_empty.solution: Add students or reactivate existing students.
config.issue.unassigned.title: {code}: {count} students without team assignment
config.issue.unassigned.impact: These students cannot be assigned correctly during regular player selection.
config.issue.unassigned.solution: Assign every active student to Team 1 or Team 2.
config.issue.no_unit.title: No active learning unit exists
config.issue.no_unit.impact: Without an active learning unit, no usable questions can be maintained for new rounds.
config.issue.no_unit.solution: Create at least one learning unit or reactivate an existing one.
config.issue.unit_no_questions.title: {code}: no active question
config.issue.unit_no_questions.impact: No question from this learning unit is currently available when assembling new rounds.
config.issue.unit_no_questions.solution: Activate an existing question or create a new question for this learning unit.
config.issue.round_incomplete.title: {name}: {count}/8 subject questions assigned
config.issue.round_incomplete.impact: The round is not ready to play because a round requires exactly 8 subject questions.
config.issue.round_incomplete.solution: Change the round assignment to exactly 8 subject questions.
config.issue.no_playable_round.title: No playable round exists
config.issue.no_playable_round.impact: No new round can currently be started because no round contains exactly 8 subject questions.
config.issue.no_playable_round.solution: Create a new round with 8 subject questions or complete an existing round.
config.issue.running.title: Running game: {round_name} · {course_code}
config.issue.running.impact: Game-relevant settings for this game are locked until the game ends.
config.issue.running.solution: Resume the running game; settings for a new game can be changed afterward.
